result.summary: Requires an ICU-capable bed for documented endotracheal intubation and mechanical ventilation, with hepatic encephalopathy, bleeding esophageal varices, and severe coagulopathy/defibrination syndrome. Latest findings include recurrent marked lactic acidosis, worsening acute kidney injury, anemia, and severe thrombocytopenia. Fall precautions are supported by encephalopathy and acute alcohol intoxication; no contact-isolation indication is documented.
result.contact_isolation_reason: No supporting organism or explicit contact precaution; MRSA screen and supplied cultures are negative.
